name: Aarav Mehta
message: The Council exists to make sure every student at Woxsen has a voice that's heard, an idea that's backed, and a campus that feels like theirs. This year, we're focused on radical transparency, more student-led events, and a stronger bridge between you and the administration.
quote: Every voice on this campus deserves a desk it can actually reach.

name: Diya Reddy
quote: Our job isn't to speak for you. It's to make sure you're heard.

name: Kabir Shah
quote: If a request goes unanswered, that's on us — write to me directly.

name: Ishita Rao
quote: Every rupee the Council spends will be on a public ledger this year.

name: Rohan Verma
quote: Campus should feel like a festival you didn't have to leave home for.

name: Meera Iyer
quote: Whether you train daily or just play on weekends — the arena is yours.

name: Aditya Nair
quote: Every tool the Council uses should be open, fast, and built by us.

name: Sara Khan
quote: Belonging isn't a perk. It's the whole point — and we're scaling it.
